The coin is alive at 30 minutes with 354 curve buyers, and the top-3 holder share is low at 9.4%, so no single wallet dominates. Net flow over the last 15 minutes was not uniformly negative in volume terms, with $78.7k traded and roughly 695 buyers in that window.

But they don't hold up. Price is down 67% over 30 minutes and 88% from its 30-minute high, with a last-15-minute return of -65%. Sellers (688) match buyers (695), net flow is -27 SOL, and the sell-to-buy ratio right after graduation was 0.96. Bundled wallets hold 32% of the curve, and the first two minutes show a launch bot present. Pool depth is only 50 SOL, so a round trip at $20 would face meaningful impact. The "ORGANIC" label doesn't offset any of this.

Recommendation: no case to buy now. Skip. A coin in this state fits the base rate of losing money, and the active sell-side pressure is the opposite of the demand the desk needs to see still present in 30-60 minutes.
memos.skeptic:
Most likely loss: a continued slide, not a rug. The coin is already down 88% from its 30-minute high and 65% over the last 15 minutes, with net flow of -27 SOL and a sell-to-buy ratio of 0.96 in the first two minutes after graduation. Sellers (688) nearly match buyers (695), so this is exit liquidity being absorbed, not a bounce. The curve shows a 32% bundle share and 27% completer share, which points to coordinated early entries that are now unwinding.

With a 50 SOL pool, a $20 ticket moves price and a 1.4-5.1% round trip is a small hurdle against a trend that has lost most of its value. Any dead-cat bounce is likely to be sold into, and fees will eat a small recovery. Skip.
